posts.post:
most guys iron their shirts. 

i let the weight of the fabric do the work.

getting home after a long trip and finally putting on your favorite pair of sweatpants. 

nothing else comes close.
buying a luxury piece and then being scared to actually wear it out is a massive waste of energy.

we removed the internal tags from the new samples. 

people think i'm crazy, but itchy skin is the enemy of style.
